description:
Find out if agents can actually pay you. PAID ($0.50 USDC on Base, x402) Seller Check: an independent test of an x402 seller endpoint. Runs the free checks, then makes one real paid call to the seller (only if the seller's price is at most $0.10) and returns a report with every check, both transaction links, pass/warn/fail, findings and fix hints. One free re-run within 7 days.

Payment: call once without payment to get the x402 v2 requirements (returned as `payment_required`), then repeat the call with the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (v2) or X-PAYMENT (v1) header on this MCP HTTP request. The same service is POST https://api.onchainagentintel.io/v1/seller-check.

Args:
    url: https URL of the paid route (required).
    method: "GET" or "POST" (optional).
    body: optional JSON body for the paid call (else the seller's own example; we never invent data).
    route: optional path to test on the url's host.
    contact_email: optional; stored, never published.
    public: true lets the result page be indexed (default private).
name: seller_check
